name: Detail transfer treated as a latent op, with clamp and raw tensor output
plain: Takes high frequencies from source and low from target. Built for images and applied to latents by permuting axes. It clamps the result to 0..1 and returns a bare tensor rather than a latent dict, so as a LATENT it is unlikely to work downstream.
math: out=(s−G s)+G t; out=lerp(t,out,ratio); optional mask lerp; out=clamp(out,0,1)
label: from code
surprise: DetailTransferLatentAdd clamps to 0..1 (utils.py:70) and returns a tensor where a dict is expected (node.py:228).
